name: Supportify AI
author: Supportify

sections.description:
Supportify AI answers your customers’ questions about orders, products, returns
and more — automatically, around the clock — using your store’s real data.

  • One-click connect. Link your store without generating or pasting REST API
    keys. You approve a secure read/write connection in your own WordPress admin
    (WooCommerce’s built-in authorization screen).
  • Storefront chat widget. Add the Supportify chat bubble to your store with a
    single widget key.
  • Real store data. The assistant looks up orders, customers, products and
    coupons through the official WooCommerce REST API.

A Supportify account is required. Per-session pricing with a free monthly tier —
see https://supportify.no.

External services

This plugin connects your store to Supportify AI, a third-party customer-support
service, to power the AI assistant and the storefront chat widget. Using the
plugin is opt-in: nothing is sent until you click “Connect to Supportify” and,
separately, enable the widget.

What the plugin does and what data is sent:

  • Connecting your store. When you click “Connect to Supportify”, the plugin
    redirects you to Supportify to start WooCommerce’s built-in authorization
    (wc-auth). After you approve, your store sends Supportify scoped WooCommerce
    REST API credentials and your store URL. Supportify uses those credentials to
    read store data (orders, customers, products, coupons) needed to answer
    customer questions, and to perform only the actions you enable (e.g. order
    cancellation, refunds, coupons, customer updates).
  • Chat widget. When you add your widget key, your storefront loads the
    Supportify widget script and sends customer chat messages (and minimal session
    context) to Supportify to generate replies.

Data sent to Supportify: your store URL, the API credentials you authorize, the
specific store records required to answer a given customer question, and chat
messages submitted through the widget. No data is sent for visitors who do not
use the chat widget.

Service provider and policies:

  • Supportify AI — https://supportify.no
  • Terms of Service — https://supportify.no/terms
  • Privacy Policy — https://supportify.no/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Supportify AI in the admin menu.
  3. Click Connect to Supportify and approve the connection in your WordPress
    admin. You’ll then sign in to Supportify to finish setup.
  4. Copy your widget key (cb_…) from the Supportify dashboard and paste it on
    the settings page to show the chat widget on your storefront.
sections.faq:
Do I need to create API keys manually?

No. The “Connect to Supportify” button uses WooCommerce’s built-in authorization
flow, so the keys are generated and handed over securely without copy/paste.

Is my data sent anywhere?

The assistant queries your store through the WooCommerce REST API to answer
customer questions. See Supportify’s privacy policy at https://supportify.no.

Pretty permalinks

WooCommerce’s REST API requires “pretty” permalinks (Settings → Permalinks → any
option other than “Plain”). The connection will not work with plain permalinks.
